title: Harden iPhone touch controls and responsive mobile layout
description: Touch controls rely on touchstart/touchend and fixed-size 16:9 controls. Real iPhones can hit touchcancel, pointer loss, app switch, lock, orientation change, and safe-area overlap. Switch to Pointer Events, clear active controls on cancel/blur/visibility changes, add touch-action/user-select safeguards, and build/test an iPhone-first landscape layout.
acceptance_criteria: No stuck controls after cancel/drag-off/app-switch/orientation-change; controls respect safe-area insets; iPhone SE through Pro Max landscape smoke tests show no HUD/control overlap.
notes:
Phase 1 landed on feat/mobile-overhaul (commits 5da4065, af79b8c, 3526058):
- Detection switched from ontouchstart capability check to matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)') with change listener
- visibilitychange/blur/pagehide/orientationchange clear keysPressed + touchStateRef + force-off siren/boost (no more stuck inputs)
- TouchControls: aria-labels on every button (Accelerate / Steer left / Steer right / Brake or reverse / Run RIDS check / Boost / Activate siren+aria-pressed / Request colleague assist), aria-hidden on glyph spans, type=button everywhere
- Safe-area insets applied on all four sides (was bottom-only) on TouchControls AND HUD
- New RotateDevicePrompt component for portrait phones, dismissible per session via sessionStorage, has aria-live polite announcement
- index.html added prefers-reduced-motion global kill-switch for animations
Pre-edit a11y review by accessibility-lead per project hook.

Outstanding for full close:
- Real iPhone smoke test SE through Pro Max (only verified in headless via bundle string check + non-touch baseline)
- Landscape layout tuning if HUD/controls overlap on small landscape phones
- Optional: keep keyboard-hint chips in DOM with hidden attr for bluetooth-keyboard-on-iPad users (a11y-lead recommended)

title: Make game loop delta-time based for mobile fairness
description: The game loop advances shift time, movement, timers, deterrence, siren, and effects using fixed per-frame values. On 120Hz iPhones the game can run too fast; under throttling it can run too slow. Convert simulation updates to elapsed delta seconds, clamp large deltas, and add regression coverage for 30/60/120fps timing.
acceptance_criteria: Shift duration and representative vehicle distance are stable across 30, 60, and 120fps simulations; countdown does not consume shift time; core timers use elapsed seconds rather than frame counts.
close_reason: Closed via fix: TDZ in constants.ts DT_* per-second rates (commit d3b78cd). Delta-time loop is now functional; bundle no longer throws ReferenceError at module init. Verified live on https://staging2.esponet.me/ — game mounts, draw:true, simulated cars=49.

title: Add privacy and abuse controls for shared leaderboard
description: The API accepts arbitrary client-submitted names, emails, scores, and timestamps with open CORS and no auth/rate limit. Before any shared leaderboard rollout, add an approved privacy notice, minimize or remove email collection, add access control/rate limiting, and decide whether scores are informal only or validated server-side.
acceptance_criteria: Leaderboard collection has approved privacy wording, PII minimization, restricted CORS/access, rate limiting or abuse mitigation, and a documented retention/deletion path.

title: Choose IT-hostable deployment and leaderboard architecture
description: Decide the deployment tier for an IT-managed link: internal Docker host behind TLS/SSO/VPN, Cloudflare Tunnel + Access, Azure/App Service or Container Apps with Entra ID, or another agency-approved path. Decide whether leaderboard is localStorage-only, SQLite with mounted volume for pilot, or managed database for production.
acceptance_criteria: Document selected hosting path, data store, auth/access model, backup/retention approach, and operational owner before public/internal rollout.
notes:
Added docs/staging-adguard-hetzner.md with AdGuard Hetzner access details, existing services, safe additive deployment shape, DNS/Caddy guidance, verification commands, and rollback notes. Guardrail: do not modify existing esponet AdGuard/monitor/sync/ntfy access; add only a new game hostname/container.
Verified Cloudflare access for esponet.me using existing Facet Cloud token from local secrets. Zone esponet.me is active/full; gd.esponet.me has no DNS record yet; adguard.esponet.me is a proxied A record to 89.167.53.198. Updated staging runbook with this, without storing token values.
Staging deployed on AdGuard Hetzner host. Public URLs verified through Cloudflare: https://gd.esponet.me and alternate https://game.esponet.me. Both proxy to general-deterrence-staging on 127.0.0.1:3100 with SQLite data under /opt/general-deterrence/data. See docs/staging-adguard-hetzner.md for DNS record ids, Caddy backups, healthcheck override, verification, and rollback.

title: Reduce per-frame React rendering cost
description: The game currently force-updates React every animation frame, reconciling the map, HUD, minimap, vehicles, and effects. This is likely to cause iPhone jank and battery drain. Move hot rendering to canvas or imperative transforms, keep static map work out of the frame loop, and throttle HUD/minimap React updates.
acceptance_criteria: In-app perf instrumentation shows stable target fps on mobile test devices or graceful 30fps fallback; HUD/minimap updates are throttled; static map does not re-render every frame.
